shared_elements: quadruped animal in profile carved in low relief on a vertical pillar face
animal placed in the upper zone of the broad face of the pillar
relief figures on an upright T-shaped/slab pillar
justification: Both show low-relief animal figures in profile on the broad upper face of an upright slab pillar, and in both the principal quadruped occupies the top of that face, which is a fairly specific shared convention. However, A depicts a single isolated elongated quadruped on an otherwise blank surface, whereas B carries a dense multi-register composition with a row of framed animals, a band of hatched/zigzag pattern, a beaked bird, a snake-like creature and further crouching figures, so the combinations and relationships largely diverge.
